# ELITE Agent Commons

Purpose: curated, machine-readable discovery of ELITE tools and research utilities.

Start here:
- README.md — purpose, quick start, trust boundaries.
- catalog/tools.json — static catalogue of tools, capabilities, formats, status, and evidence notes.
- elite_commons/cli.py — deterministic list, search, route, and validation commands.
- AGENTS.md — safe agent-use instructions.
- SECURITY.md — reporting and security boundaries.
- LICENSE-STATUS.md — current licensing status.

Discovery is not authorization. Do not execute listed tools without separate review and approval. Catalogue capability claims are not a safety certification.
